manifest.name: dsh-approval-card
manifest.description: Approve tool requests from any session in place, without switching back to its conversation.

bundle.text:
# dsh-approval-card bundle patch
# id 必须等于 client.js 里 __ModuleLoader__.load({ id }) 的值，否则客户端会报
# "loaded without registering ..."。name 必须是实际包名（cordis 按 name import）。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-approval-card
      name: dsh-approval-card

readme.text:
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-approval-card)
[](https://github.com/Ystian2k/dsh-approval-card/blob/main/LICENSE)

Surface pending **tool approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session** as a card on the right side of the DSH web UI — and **answer them in place**, without switching back to the session that asked.

Unlike reminder-only plugins, the buttons here actually answer the request: they call the official `pendingInteraction.answer('allowed-once' | 'rejected')`.

**Design note — it does not hijack the approval waterfall.** The plugin only *reads* `uiSession.sessionStatus` and calls the official `answer()`. It never registers its own `approval/request` listener, so if it fails to load, throws, or its overlay is torn down by an SPA route change, the built-in approval card keeps working. Approvals can never be stranded.

- Compatible with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` — verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`, earlier `0.2.1-rc.*` declared but untested
- Client-side only — the host half (`index.js`) is intentionally near-empty
- Five color themes, seven tunable parameters, named presets, usage stats
- MIT

English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

---

在**当前对话**里就能处理**其他对话**排队中的审批，不用切回去点卡片。

插件**不接管** `approval/request` waterfall。

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval` 会把每条待审批登记成一个 `PendingApproval`
对象，放进客户端 `uiSession` 服务的 `sessionStatus` 快照里：

```
uiSession.sessionStatus.getSnapshot() → Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>
```

`pendingInteraction` 自带 `answer('allowed-once' | 'rejected')`，就是官方按钮调的那个方法。
本插件订阅这份快照，把各处待审批渲染成右侧卡片，点按钮时直接调 `answer()`。

因此：

- 官方审批卡照常出现，当前会话的体验与原生一致；
- 本插件加载失败、服务名变化、渲染出错 —— 都只是卡片不出现，
  **审批本身仍由官方 UI 完成**，不可能再把审批卡死。

> 历史教训：早先的实现是 `remote.$on('approval/request', ...)` 并返回自己解决的 Promise。
> waterfall 是「谁先作答谁赢」，官方卡片于是拿不到请求；一旦卡片没能显示出来，
> 这笔审批就彻底没有 UI（表现为「审批根本出不来」）。

注册到官方的 `shell.overlay` 槽位（覆盖整帧的浮层，位置自己定）：

```
position: fixed; right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%)
flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto
```

- **右侧、竖直居中**：多笔审批时每笔一张卡纵向堆叠，整体包围盒的中点落在屏幕竖直中线上；
- 卡片默认宽 320px（可调），浅色（白米底 + 琥珀描边 + 深色实心「允许一次」），与官方审批卡同一套语言；
- 内容：`● 等待审批` + 会话名 / 工具名 / 原因（最多 3 行）/ `拒绝` `允许一次`。

按 `pendingInteraction.kind` 分岔，同一份快照里混着也能一起显示：

| kind | 卡片 | 提交 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval` | 等待审批 / 工具名 / 原因 / 拒绝·允许一次 | `answer('allowed-once' \| 'rejected')` |
| `plan-review` | 需要回答 / 计划正文（可滚动）/ 批准·拒绝 | `{ answers: [{ id, selected: [label] }] }` |
| `question` | 需要回答 / 题目 + 选项（单选·多选）+ 输入框 | 同上，可带 `custom` |

自定义输入按官方规则拼 payload：

- 没填 → `{ id, selected: [labels…] }`
- 填了 + 单选 → `{ id, selected: [], custom: "…" }`
- 填了 + 多选 → `{ id, selected: [labels…], custom: "…" }`

`plan-review` 不是独立类型：`PendingQuestion` 的 `kind` 由 `planReviewOf(questions)`
决定（单题、单选、`options ≤ 2`、能匹配 `intent.approve`），`questions[0].detail` 是计划正文。

组件只 `createQuestionPane()` 一次。每次渲染都新建一个组件函数会让 React
认为类型变了、卸载重挂，`useState` 里的选中状态每 800ms 轮询都被清空
（表现为"点好几下也选不中"）。

同一会话里的多笔审批，官方只保留一个 `pendingInteraction` 槽位
（`publishPendingInteractions` 按 `sessionId` 合并），所以同会话并发只显示最新一笔；
**跨会话**才能同时看到多张卡。

- 只在 **Windows + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.5`** 上实测过；`peerDependencies` 声明的是
  `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`，`rc.3` / `rc.4` 未经测试——如果看不到卡片，官方审批卡仍照常工作
  （插件不接管 waterfall）。版本跨度更大时请先确认官方 API 没变（关键依赖是
  `uiSession.sessionStatus` 与 `shell.overlay` 槽位）。
- 浏览器侧插件，**DSH 窗口最小化时看不到卡片**（审批不会丢，恢复窗口后仍在）。
- 同会话并发只显示最新一笔（见上）。

readme.section: 为什么不用自己量位置
readme.text:
早先版本用 `position: fixed` + 量 composer 的 `getBoundingClientRect()` 来对齐，
在审批接管 composer 时会量到 `0×0`（官方是「把默认 composer 盖在下面」，不是卸载），
于是横条被缓存值钉死。官方文档对此有明确禁令：

> Do not read another plugin's DOM, stylesheet, or component source to estimate placement;
> choose a slot that already allocates space.
> —— `dsh-agent-preset/skills/cordis-plugin-development/references/ui-plugin.md`

现在的做法就是「选一个已经分配好空间的槽位」。

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
npm i dsh-approval-card
```

然后编辑同一个目录下的 `package.json`，把它加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["...", "dsh-approval-card"]
  }

完全退出 DSH 再启动（改了 `package.json` 需要重启，不是刷新）。

装好后右侧平时是空的——**只有存在待审批/待回答时卡片才出现**，处理完自动消失。
参数在「设置 → 审批浮层」里调。

三个文件的分工：

```
package.json          # dsh.client.inject / dsh.bundle.patch
cordis.patch.yml      # id 必须等于 client.js 里 __ModuleLoader__.load({ id })
index.js              # 宿主半边：默认空实现
client.js             # 客户端：注册 shell.overlay 卡片的 React 组件

用 `link:` 方式挂本地源码时，部署到两处（必须 md5 一致）：

```
~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-approval-card/client.js
~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-approval-card/client.js
```

改客户端代码后 **Ctrl+R 即可**（控制台会出现
`[dsh-approval-card] mounted mode-ready build=<版本>`）；只有改 `index.js` / `package.json`
才需要退出应用重启。

默认不写文件、不发网络请求。需要看内部状态时：

1. 浏览器控制台执行 `localStorage.setItem('dsh-approval-card:debug', '1')`，刷新——卡片会把自检信息 POST 给宿主；
2. 以 `DSH_APPROVAL_CARD_DEBUG=1` 启动 DSH，宿主才会注册 `/dsh-approval-card/report` 并把回贴写进 `~/.dsh/approval-card-debug.log`。

两个开关都关掉时，插件除了渲染卡片之外不产生任何副作用。

readme.section: 可调参数（设置 → 审批浮层）
readme.text:
不同屏幕尺寸下默认值兜不住，所以都做成可调的：

| 参数 | 默认 | 范围 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 卡片宽度 | 320px | 240–560 | 卡片有多宽（右侧贴边，变宽向左扩） |
| 顶部留白 | 50px | 0–200 | 卡片顶部内边距 |
| 底部留白 | 280px | 0–400 | 滚到底时最后一条与窗口底部的距离（避开右下角悬浮控件） |
| 最大高度 | 75vh | 40–100 | 超过就出滚动条 |
| 顶部渐隐 | 50px | 0–80 | 上边缘淡出多少（只在可滚动时出现） |
| 底部渐隐 | 50px | 0–80 | 下边缘淡出多少 |
| 字体大小 | 14px | 10–18 | 正文基准，小标签 −1、最小字 −2 |

每项都有滑块可拖（拖动即生效）；也可以直接在数字框里输入，失焦或回车才保存。
存放在 `localStorage[dsh-approval-card:settings]`；
ShellBar 每 800ms 重读一次，所以改完不用刷新（页面底部有「已保存 / 有未保存的修改」提示）。

设置页底部显示「本插件已处理：允许 N 次 · 拒绝 M 次 · 回答 K 次」，以及最近一次的时间。

只统计**通过本插件**完成的动作（点卡片按钮 / 提交回答），用官方卡片处理的不计。
存在 `localStorage[dsh-approval-card:stats]`，字段 `allowed / rejected / answers / lastAt`。

五套色相：琥珀（默认，与官方审批卡一致）、靛蓝、松绿、紫藤、樱粉。
设置页里点色点即换，卡片底色、描边、选中态、主按钮会一起换。存在 `hue` 字段。

两档：`详细`（会话名 + 工具名 + 原因）与 `简略`（只留一行「会话名 · 工具名」）。
存在 `detail` 字段，默认 `full`。

设置页可把当前整套参数（含配色、详细度）命名存下来，列表里点「应用」即恢复，点「删除」移除。
存在 `localStorage[dsh-approval-card:templates]`，格式 `{ 模板名: { ...settings } }`。
「恢复默认值」回到代码里的 `DEFAULTS`；「查看当前参数」显示一行 JSON，方便复制备份。

---

The plugin **does not intercept** the `approval/request` waterfall.

The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval` registers every pending approval as a
`PendingApproval` object inside the client-side `uiSession` service's `sessionStatus` snapshot:

```
uiSession.sessionStatus.getSnapshot() → Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>
```

`pendingInteraction` already carries `answer('allowed-once' | 'rejected')` — the same method the
official buttons call. This plugin subscribes to that snapshot, renders each pending item as a card
on the right, and calls `answer()` when you click.

Consequently:

- the official approval card still appears; the current session behaves exactly as before;
- if this plugin fails to load, the service name changes, or rendering throws — the only result is
  that the card doesn't appear. **The approval itself is still handled by the official UI**, so it
  can never get stuck.

> Historical note: an early version did `remote.$on('approval/request', ...)` and resolved the
> request itself. A waterfall is "first answer wins", so the official card never received the
> request — and if our overlay failed to render, that approval had **no UI at all**.

Registered into the official `shell.overlay` slot (a full-frame overlay; you choose the position):

```
position: fixed; right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%)
flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto
```

- **Right side, vertically centered**: multiple approvals stack as one card each, and the center of
  the whole stack sits on the viewport's vertical midline.
- Card width defaults to 320px (adjustable). Light theme (off-white background, amber border, solid
  dark "Allow once" button) — the same visual language as the official approval card.
- Contents: `● Waiting for approval` + session name / tool name / reason (up to 3 lines) /
  `Reject` `Allow once`.

readme.section: All three kinds of pending items
readme.text: Branching on `pendingInteraction.kind`, so a snapshot containing a mix of them renders together:

readme.section: All three kinds of pending items
readme.text:
| kind | Card | Submitted payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval` | waiting for approval / tool / reason / reject·allow once | `answer('allowed-once' \| 'rejected')` |
| `plan-review` | needs an answer / plan body (scrollable) / approve·reject | `{ answers: [{ id, selected: [label] }] }` |
| `question` | needs an answer / question + options (single·multi) + free-text input | same, optionally with `custom` |

Free-text input is assembled by the official rule:

readme.section: All three kinds of pending items
readme.text:
- nothing typed → `{ id, selected: [labels…] }`
- typed + single select → `{ id, selected: [], custom: "…" }`
- typed + multi select → `{ id, selected: [labels…], custom: "…" }`

`plan-review` is not a separate type: it is a `PendingQuestion` whose `kind` is decided by
`planReviewOf(questions)` (single question, single select, `options ≤ 2`, matching
`intent.approve`). `questions[0].detail` holds the plan body.

readme.section: All three kinds of pending items
readme.text:
The question pane is created **once** (`createQuestionPane()` outside render). Creating a new
component function on every render makes React treat it as a changed type, unmount and remount it,
which wipes the `useState` selections every 800ms poll — the symptom is "clicking several times
never selects anything".

Within a single session the official UI keeps only **one** `pendingInteraction` slot
(`publishPendingInteractions` merges by `sessionId`), so concurrent approvals in the *same* session
show only the most recent one. Multiple *sessions* can show multiple cards simultaneously.

- Only tested on **Windows + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.5`**. `peerDependencies` declares
  `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`; `rc.3` / `rc.4` are untested — if the card does not appear, the built-in
  approval UI still works (the plugin does not take over the waterfall). For a wider version gap,
  check that the official API is unchanged (`uiSession.sessionStatus` and the `shell.overlay` slot).
- This is a browser-side plugin: **if the DSH window is minimized there is no visible card**
  (approvals are not lost — they are still there when you restore the window).
- Same-session concurrency shows only the latest item (see above).

readme.section: Why it does not measure the DOM
readme.text:
An early version used `position: fixed` plus `composer.getBoundingClientRect()` to line itself up.
While an approval takes over the composer it measures `0×0` — the official shell *covers* the
default composer rather than unmounting it — so the bar got pinned to a cached value. The official
docs forbid this approach outright:

readme.section: Why it does not measure the DOM
readme.text:
> Do not read another plugin's DOM, stylesheet, or component source to estimate placement;
> choose a slot that already allocates space.
> — `dsh-agent-preset/skills/cordis-plugin-development/references/ui-plugin.md`

The current implementation simply chooses a slot that already allocates space.

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
npm i dsh-approval-card
```

Then edit `package.json` in the same directory and add it to `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["...", "dsh-approval-card"]
  }

Fully quit and restart DSH (changing `package.json` requires a restart, not a reload).

Nothing sits on the right side by default — **the card only appears while there is something to
approve or answer**, and disappears once handled. Parameters live under
**Settings → Approval card**.

The four files:

```
package.json          # dsh.client.inject / dsh.bundle.patch
cordis.patch.yml      # id must equal __ModuleLoader__.load({ id }) in client.js
index.js              # host half: empty by default
client.js             # client half: the React component registered into shell.overlay

When linking local sources with `link:`, deploy to both locations (md5 must match):

```
~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-approval-card/client.js
~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-approval-card/client.js
```

After changing client code, **Ctrl+R is enough** (the console prints
`[dsh-approval-card] mounted mode-ready build=<version>`). Only changes to `index.js` /
`package.json` require quitting and restarting the app.

By default the plugin writes no files and makes no network requests. To inspect internal state:

1. In the browser console run `localStorage.setItem('dsh-approval-card:debug', '1')` and reload —
   the card then POSTs self-check data to the host;
2. Start DSH with `DSH_APPROVAL_CARD_DEBUG=1`; only then does the host register
   `/dsh-approval-card/report` and append the reports to `~/.dsh/approval-card-debug.log`.

With both switches off, the plugin has no side effects beyond rendering the card.

| Parameter | Default | Range | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card width | 320px | 240–560 | How wide the card is (right-aligned, grows leftwards) |
| Top padding | 50px | 0–200 | Inner padding at the top of the card |
| Bottom padding | 280px | 0–400 | Gap between the last item and the window bottom when scrolled to the end (keeps clear of floating controls in the bottom-right corner) |
| Max height | 75vh | 40–100 | Beyond this, a scrollbar appears |
| Top fade | 50px | 0–80 | Fade-out at the top edge (only when scrollable) |
| Bottom fade | 50px | 0–80 | Fade-out at the bottom edge |
| Font size | 14px | 10–18 | Body baseline; small labels −1, tiny text −2 |

Each parameter has a draggable slider (takes effect immediately) and a number input (saved on blur
or Enter). Values are stored in `localStorage['dsh-approval-card:settings']`; the component re-reads
them every 800ms, so no reload is needed (the bottom of the section shows
"✓ Saved" / "Unsaved changes").

The bottom of the settings section shows "Handled by this plugin: allow N · reject M · answer K"
plus the timestamp of the most recent action.

Only actions completed **through this plugin** are counted (clicking a card button, submitting an
answer); handling something via the official card is not counted. Stored in
`localStorage['dsh-approval-card:stats']` with fields `allowed / rejected / answers / lastAt`.

Five themes: amber (default, matching the official approval card), indigo, pine, wisteria, sakura.
Pick one in settings and the card background, border, selected state and primary button all follow.
Stored in the `hue` field.

Two levels: `full` (session name + tool name + reason) and `compact` (a single line
`session name · tool name`). Stored in the `detail` field, default `full`.

The settings section can save the whole parameter set (including theme and detail level) under a
name; click Apply to restore it or Delete to remove it. Stored in
`localStorage['dsh-approval-card:templates']` as `{ name: { ...settings } }`.
"Restore defaults" returns to the `DEFAULTS` in code; "Show current parameters" prints a one-line
JSON string that is easy to copy and back up.
